policy: Curated existing-term catalogue with Schema.org. No local term definitions. Kinds specify supported application usage; generic RDF source properties may be projected to OWL object/datatype declarations for this profile. This is not automatic full-vocabulary retrieval.

terms.label: Agent
terms.definition: An entity capable of acting.
terms.usage_note: Not specifically an author or a person; select more specific approved terms when justified.

terms.label: Bibliographic Resource
terms.definition: A documentary resource such as a book or article.
terms.usage_note: Broader than journal article. Use an approved specific article class when needed.

terms.label: Identifier
terms.definition: An unambiguous reference within a context.
terms.usage_note: Use literal identifier values in this application profile. Does not guarantee a PID scheme or uniqueness.

terms.label: Creator
terms.definition: An entity responsible for creating a resource.
terms.usage_note: This profile uses creator entities, not name strings. Broader than authorship; schema:author is more specific for authorship.

terms.label: Title
terms.definition: A name for a resource.

terms.label: Description
terms.definition: An account of a resource.

terms.label: Subject
terms.definition: The topic of a resource.
terms.usage_note: This profile uses topic concepts, not keyword strings.

terms.label: cites
terms.definition: Connects a citing entity to the cited entity.

terms.label: is cited by
terms.definition: Connects a cited entity to the entity citing it.
terms.usage_note: Published inverse of cito:cites. Query cito:cites backwards if you do not materialize inverse facts.

terms.label: Cataloged Resource
terms.definition: A resource represented in a catalogue.

terms.label: Dataset
terms.definition: A collection of data available for access or download.
terms.usage_note: Description in a source graph does not by itself prove current access or download availability.

terms.label: Catalog
terms.definition: A curated collection of resource metadata.
terms.usage_note: An RDF graph is not automatically a catalogue. Do not subclass SourceGraph under Catalog just to pass validation.

terms.label: dataset
terms.definition: Links a catalogue to a dataset listed in it.
terms.usage_note: Use only for genuine catalogue membership; do not use it to describe arbitrary RDF graph containment.

terms.label: keyword
terms.definition: A keyword or tag describing a resource.
terms.usage_note: Literal values; DCAT 3 does not impose the old DCAT 1 Dataset domain.

terms.label: theme
terms.definition: A category used to classify a resource.
terms.usage_note: A controlled subject concept; dcterms:subject is a broader alternative.

terms.label: Concept
terms.definition: A unit of thought used in a knowledge organization system.

terms.label: Thing
terms.definition: The most general kind of thing.

terms.label: Creative work
terms.definition: A creative work, including books, articles, software and other works.
terms.usage_note: Broader than publication. Scope scholarly/documentary results in queries.

terms.label: Article
terms.definition: An article, including news, magazine and other article types.

terms.label: Scholarly article
terms.definition: A scholarly article.
terms.usage_note: Prefer for scholarly article results in CQ_001.

terms.label: Book
terms.definition: A book.

terms.label: Report
terms.definition: A report produced by a governmental or non-governmental organisation.

terms.label: Person
terms.definition: A person.
terms.usage_note: A person may act as an author; do not create a separate local Author class.

terms.label: Organization
terms.definition: An organisation.
terms.usage_note: An organisation may be an author.

terms.label: author
terms.definition: The author of a creative work or rating.
terms.usage_note: Expected values include schema:Person and schema:Organization. These are alternatives, not an intersection. Schema.org expected types are not global OWL domain/range restrictions.

terms.label: preferred label
terms.definition: A preferred lexical label.
terms.usage_note: May be language-tagged. Use langString or string in the profile as needed.
